steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include acyclovir sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 211 tablets of the 400 mg presentation at 15.5 per day, giving 13.6 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 502 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 13 per day, giving 38.5 days on hand.
Corvale General also holds 339 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 15.4 per day, giving 22 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 101 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 4.1 per day, giving 24.8 days on hand.
The rule-ranked alternate manufacturer is Eugia US LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Check whether current purchase orders align with the lowest on-hand site (13.6 days) and confirm Eugia US LLC availability before placing new orders.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
